label: input u late in the original phase of sequences starting with h
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase, almost always (99% of mass) when the input token is u at steps 4-8 (peaks at t=5). Strongly conditioned on the first original token being h (88% of mass; y-first sequences contribute a weaker ~8%). Never fires on the delimiter or copy phases, or on u at t<4. The predicate catches 77% of activations and 87% of mass, but precision is only ~22%: most h...u (t>=4) steps stay silent, and the remaining dependence on intervening tokens is diffuse (h y prefixes, earlier n/p/y tokens, and fewer digits raise the rate, with stronger activations among them) and could not be captured cleanly. Magnitude is largest for h-first sequences, particularly those starting h y.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=h (+5.42), orig0=y (+3.08), prev_tok=p (+2.71), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=u (+2.03), phase=0 & in_tok=u (+2.03), orig1=y (+1.96). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-2.67), orig_idx=-1 (-2.54), prev_tok=h (-1.90), prev_tok=m (-1.36).
